page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top left and top centre, page number top right, a "Cap. I." heading in the right margin beside the top lines; handwritten marginal notes in the right margin (not transcribed as printed text, only noted); a centred section heading "SECTIO QVINTA" mid-page; body text below; catchword "qui-" at lower right.

main_text.l: prie informet. Sed jam ἄλλᾳ βοηθείᾳ; verbum non
amplius addimus de Privatione. & sicui haec omnia non-
dum satisfaciunt (animis enim pertinaciter in aliqua secta
obfirmatis nulla rationum momenta satisfacere queant) ille
Materiam primam & Formam substantialem asserat prius à
nostris objectionibus, & postea super Privatione pedem
nobiscum conferat. namq; illis sublatis hanc ne ipsi qui-
dem posuerint Peripatetici.
SECTIO QVINTA.
Transitur ad examinandam Aristotelis sententiam de Causis. Principia
sua Aristoteles & Aristotelici etiam
Elementa vocant. A Causis potius quam à Principiis
incipere debuerat Aristoteles. II. Aristotelis scopus in
tractatione de Principiis ac Causis. III. In quibus
culpemus tractationem Aristotelis de Causis, in secun-
do Physicorum institutam. IV. Vanitas istius axio-
matis, Efficiens, Formam & Finem, idem esse in
naturalibus. V. Difficultas, quomodo Agentia naturalia,
cognitionis expertia, agant propter finem: &
Aristotelis ad eam responsio. VI. Cavillatoria vanitas i-
stius responsi; aliag in eo
absurda. VII. Quod Aristoteles statuit, Naturam agere propter finem; in eo
nihil novi dixit, quum recepta Veterum
haec fuerit sententia. VIII. Vera Veterum assertio, Agentia na-
turalia agere ex congenitâ necessitate: explicatur. IX.
Aristotelis inconstantia: sententiam modo dictam ma-
ligne detorquet. X. Incusatur Aristoteles, quod nihil
de natura ac modo operandi Finalis Causae tradiderit.
Absurda plerorumq; Aristotelicorum opinio, Finem
agere secundum esse regale. XI. Absurditas Peripateti-
corum, negantium Causalitatem Finis consistere in
motu, quo ciet appetitum. Finis non est peculiare Causae
genus, sed Efficientis quaedam species. XII. Aliy defec-
tus in hac tractatione de Fine. Epilogus totius disqui-

marginalia.note: quam, cur, quando, quomodo, quo fine, quo facto.
Ipse, tantundem, Indifferenter, promiscuum, coincidens, codem sensu, contendere, distinguere, pro aequo, quomodo, aequali.

page.notes: The right-margin handwritten annotations are in manuscript and are only summarised as notes; their readings are uncertain. The final word of the page is printed as "disqui-" with the catchword "qui-" below. Several Greek words in the first paragraph are uncertain ([?] not marked due to low legibility). Show-through and stains are not transcribed.
